title: Track registry installs and review three-way upgrades before apply
problemCues: Installed Shine/registry block may have newer upstream
decision: Track installed baseline. Review three-way changes without --apply first. Applying checks compatibility; conflicts leave all sources unchanged.
exceptions: Untracked one-off forks explicitly owned by the consumer
example: records pilot upgrade track on DataGrid
validatedBy: upgrade check receipt; conflict leaves tree unchanged
